summary: LogicMark, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor for the sale of 250,000 Series J Convertible Preferred Shares at $1.00 per share, closing July 30, 2026. Each share has a stated value of $1.28, is convertible after October 30, 2026 at a 50% discount to the lowest traded price over the prior 30 trading days, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap, and carries two votes per share. No dividends; liquidation preference senior to common but junior to Series C. This is a distressed equity financing with highly dilutive conversion terms—a classic 'death spiral' convertible, not a standard special situation. Watch for future conversions and potential SEC scrutiny.
